thread:
tess: Support flagged a new user who completed the quickstart but their first SDK request returned 402 and the client gave no guidance. They hit a hard stop.

omar: Do we have the gateway/proxy body for the 402? That usually tells if it's billing_required or trial_limit.

tess: Gateway returned: 
```json
{"status":402, "code":"billing_required", "request_id":"req_qs_2026", "workspace_id":"ws_new_42"}
```

gina: Thanks. Two quick notes: (1) JS SDK currently treats some 4xxs as transient and does one retry in our fetch wrapper; that makes 402 confusing. (2) Sample servers running under dev proxies like `vercel dev` can drop `x-workspace-id`, which makes the request land in a different workspace and trigger billing gates.

tess: I repro'ed locally: clone `redwood-quickstart`, set `REDWOOD_KEY` to the user's key, `yarn dev` under `vercel dev`, incognito. Click demo -> client shows `Request failed with status code 402` (axios stack). No link or hint.

omar: Proposed SDK change: map HTTP 402 -> OnboardingBillingError, mark non-retriable, attach `help_url` to `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing` and an `admin_hint` string like "Ask your org admin to complete billing at /orgs/<org>/billing". Also include `request_id` and `workspace_id` in Sentry breadcrumbs (no secrets).

gina: Sample app fix: detect missing `x-workspace-id` and print a loud dev-mode console/server warning with remediation. Example snippet: 
```js
if (!req.headers['x-workspace-id']) {
  console.warn('Missing x-workspace-id. If you are using Vercel/Netlify dev CLI, enable header forwarding or run the server directly. This can cause requests to hit the wrong workspace and trigger billing gates.');
}
```

tess: Docs: quickstart README should add a "First call 402" troubleshooting section that shows the exact payload and steps to check workspace billing in the console. Also mention the vercel/netlify caveat.

rafa: I'll take the sample change and README patch (today). Omar, can you open the SDK PR to standardize 402 across JS/Python/Go (48h)? Gina, can you add a Sentry grouping key?

omar: Yep. I'll make the SDK change to return a structured error with fields `type: 'onboarding_billing'`, `help_url`, and `retriable:false`. Will add unit tests to ensure no retry path triggers.

gina: I'll add Sentry grouping `onboard.billing_required` and include `request_id` and `workspace_id` breadcrumbs. I'll also add a note in the SDK changelog so support knows the new error type.

ci-bot: Suggested automated DM to end-users who hit 402: "It looks like your organization needs to complete billing setup. Visit https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for steps or contact your org admin. If you're blocked after that, reply here and support will help."

rafa: One extra improvement: onboard-bot could detect repeated 402s and offer to send an admin invite flow (low-priority). I'll file that as a follow-up.

tess: Support will DM the affected user with the docs link and keep ticket open until SDK/samples land. Thanks all — this should cut down first-call confusion. :thumbsup:
